scripts.check: pnpm -s run secrets:scan && pnpm -s run lint:ci && pnpm -s run type-check && pnpm -s run build && pnpm -s run test && pnpm -s run test:browser && pnpm -s run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.check:headless: pnpm -s run setup:headless && pnpm -s run check
scripts.test: node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped && node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test:integration --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:affected: node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test --affected --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped && node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test:integration --affected --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/run-env.mjs TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs -- run test:browser --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: node scripts/run-env.mjs CI=true pnpm_config_ci=false -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs -- run test:e2e:lane:smoke --filter=@brainstrike/desktop --output-logs=new-only
